requirements.statement: Preserve the commercial description and confirmed price of historical and accepted orders despite catalog changes or deactivation.
Retain ingredients, regulated allergens, known traces, dietary labels, and cross-contact notices for each sellable configuration.
Show allergens for the selected final configuration and repeat them in the order summary before confirmation.
Present the option as a gluten-free dough option and do not claim suitability for coeliac customers or severe allergies unless separately validated.
When published allergen information is incorrect, disable affected new sales, identify accepted undelivered affected orders, route them to review, and preserve the incident and correction trail.
Present only manually configured, active, available, published, allergen-complete, and dietary-compatible recommendations for drinks, desserts, or eligible extras.
Keep upselling optional, non-blocking, limited to three recommendations overall, and free of automatic item or quantity additions.
Record aggregate recommendation impressions and additions by placement without persistent individual recommendation profiles.
After order submission, send an SMS providing secure access to private order tracking.
Send an SMS when an order is ready, rejected, or cancelled by staff and do not send a redundant acceptance SMS.
Require an opaque, time-limited access mechanism or protected browser session for private tracking; a sequential public order code alone shall not authorise access.
Limit SMS content to Dopis identification, general status, and the private tracking link rather than complete order details.
Show every material estimate revision on private tracking and send additional SMS messages according to the validated operational communication rule.
Use payment at the premises and exclude online payment from the first operational MVP.
Allow staff to record the payment method actually used at collection as cash or card.
Keep payment and handover as separate events and prevent handover unless an accepted payment method succeeds.
Preserve prior events, actor, time, and required reason for corrections to payment method, paid state, or handover state.
At shift close, compare expected and actual cash, record any explanation, review open orders and incidents, and require responsible confirmation.
Provide a visible queue for orders, failures, or customer responses requiring staff attention.
Keep material incidents, corrections, reopenings, and safe interim measures traceable without deleting prior history.
When a problem exceeds authorised rules, allow staff to pause only the affected product, option, channel, or capability when unaffected operation remains safe.
